<thought>The proposed SMILES "COC(=O)C1=CC=C(C=C1)CCCC" corresponds to methyl 4‑butylbenzoate (C₁₂H₁₆O₂). Its formula matches the mass‑spectrometry ion (M+H ≈ 193) and the 13C NMR shows 11 distinct signals with two pairs of equivalent aromatic carbons, a carbonyl at ~166 ppm, an O‑CH₃ at ~52 ppm, benzylic and aliphatic carbons matching the observed chemical shifts. Therefore this SMILES satisfies the experimental data.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(=O)C1=CC=C(C=C1)CCCC</final_answer>
